parsed.post: Keeping the improvement (0.9914 -> 0.9891). It seems adding WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 helped stabilize the DEPTH=6 model. Next, I'll test if a slightly higher learning rate (0.06) helps the deeper model converge better within the 5-minute window, while keeping the current successful stack.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.06 to see if it accelerates convergence for the DEPTH=6 model with WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1.
